notes: Backup source: LastRank's alliance list was stale, so this export reads lwservers.com's public warzone 927 snapshot (generated 2026-09-27T04:02:38.632Z).

88 profiles were confirmed by lwservers within 24 hours with a dated reading (user rule: data no more than 1 day old): hero power read for 83, power for 68, kills for 50; any stat lwservers did not read keeps its tracker value, as each row's profile.fieldSources records. Profession and alliance rank are always kept: lwservers' values for both are undated.

12 rows keep their existing tracker name, rank, statistics and dates unaltered: 클래식 classic, ApacheJohn, Gino the chaos, Leandro Pinto, BadLui, I  Mystery  l, KrlZ, derpynoob, art 1, fALIENangel, Special KK, Youmei Qiu.
1 lwservers RSCL players have no tracker record with their game UID and were skipped at the user's request: Tymmers.
4 active tracker members are absent from the lwservers RSCL rows (art 1, fALIENangel, Special KK, Youmei Qiu); they stay active with existing values unaltered.
